## About
Earth First Landscapes is a landscaping construction and maintenance firm in Katy, serving commercial properties around Houston. We plan, install and care for grounds that stay clean, healthy and good looking for the long haul.
Good commercial landscaping takes understanding what you need, a clear plan, quality materials, careful installation and steady maintenance. We work within your budget from the first design to the ongoing care, and if another company has left your project in rough shape, we'll walk it with you and give you an honest evaluation.
Our promise is simple: no surprises. Customers rate us 4.2 on Google from 48 reviews.

## Services
- Land development: Planning and building commercial landscapes for your property.
- Grounds maintenance: Ongoing care to keep your property clean, healthy and looking its best.
- Flower bed design and install: One reviewer hired us to design and install the flower beds at their apartment complex entrance and said the flowers look fantastic.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of properties do you work on?
A: We focus on commercial landscaping. Our clients include community associations, developers, property management firms, commercial property owners, municipal agencies, general contractors, landscape architects and sports field owners.

Q: How do I get a bid?
A: Fill out the Instant Bid form on our website and tell us about your landscaping needs.

Q: When is your office open?
A: Monday through Friday during business hours. We're closed on weekends.
